change.rootCause: Vite's CSS post-plugin asks assetFileNames for a guessed stylesheet output directory before Rollup expands [name]. Grouped CSS names contain slashes, so the literal assets/[name]-[hash][extname] pattern made Vite compute relative public-asset URLs from assets/ while Rollup emitted CSS under assets/<group>/.
change.fix: Generated assets now flatten the basename of grouped names while retaining content hashes and extensions. Configured static-root assets still use their canonical source paths.
change.fixtureCoverage: The existing legacy Chromium fixture retains an HTML-linked stylesheet, CSS url(), and image-set() references to public/assets; no coverage was removed or skipped.
